{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute raw response rates by arm
treatment_rate = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_rate = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute raw difference: treatment - control
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Print results
print(f"Treatment response rate: {treatment_rate}")
print(f"Control response rate: {control_rate}")
print(f"Raw treatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect}")"}
